Verses.1: If I speak in human and angelic tongues but do not have love, I am only a noisy gong or clanging cymbal.
Verses.2: If I have the gift of prophecy that grasps all mysteries and knowledge, without love, I am nothing. If I have faith that can move mountains but do not have love, I am nothing.
Verses.3: And if I give all I possess to charity and sacrifice my body, but do not have love, it does me no good.
Verses.4: Love is patient. Love is kind. Love does not envy or boast. It is not arrogant.
Verses.5: It does not act disgracefully. It is not self-seeking. Love is not provoked. It keeps no record of wrongs.
Verses.6: Love takes no delight in evil, but rejoices with the truth.
Verses.7: Love forgives all things and believes all things. Love hopes all things and endures all things.
Verses.8: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease. Where there are tongues, they will be silenced. Where there is knowledge, it will disappear.
Verses.9: Now we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
Verses.10: When the perfect comes, what is partial will disappear.
Verses.11: When I was a child I spoke like a child, thought like a child, and reasoned like a child. When I became an adult, I stopped doing these childish things.
Verses.12: For now we see a dim reflection in a mirror, but then we will see face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will fully know,  as I have been known fully.
Verses.13: Now these three remain: faith, hope and love; but the greatest of these is love.
